faq.question: Q1. What is DHAS Delhi Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a walk-in recruitment drive conducted by Dr. Hedgewar Arogya Sansthan to fill 6 contract vacancies for Senior Resident posts in Anaesthesia, Obs & Gynae, Surgery, and Radiology.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DHAS Delhi Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available across Anaesthesia (1), Obs & Gynae (1), Surgery (1), and Radiology (3).

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview for DHAS Delhi Senior Resident?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 15 October 2026, with registration open from 9:30 AM till 11:30 AM. Radiology department interviews continue on a daily basis from 15 October 2026 except weekends.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an MBBS with a post graduate Degree/Diploma/DNB in the concerned specialty from a recognized institution and possess a valid registration with the Delhi Medical Council.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for DHAS Delhi Senior Resident?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years for General candidates, with relaxations of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 5 years extra for Persons with Disabilities.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can fill out the prescribed format and report for registration at the Establishment Branch, DHAS Hospital, Karkardooma, Delhi, on 15 October 2026 between 9:30 AM and 11:30 AM with all original documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for DHAS Delhi Senior Resident?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a pay scale of Level 11 (Rs. 67,700-2,08,700/-) plus allowances as admissible.
